department: Department of Chemistry (Faculty of SCIENCE PhD School)

deadline.value: No central deadline: apply to advertised PhD positions on the UCPH job portal, each with its own deadline.
deadline.quote: Look for advertised PhD positions at the University's job portal.

also.quote: The deadline for applications is October 30th 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

supervisor.value: You must have an agreement with a principal supervisor at the Faculty of Science before you apply for admission.
supervisor.quote: You must have a principal supervisor employed at one of the departments at the Faculty of Science, and you must have an agreement with your supervisor before you apply for admission.

also.quote: Applicants must have an agreement with a principal supervisor.

funding.value: No unfunded admission: you need funding for salary and tuition fee to enrol, usually employment as a PhD fellow.
funding.quote: To be enrolled as a PhD student, the applicant must have funding for salary and tuition fee. | Employment as a PhD fellow at the faculty

entry_route.value: The regular 3-year PhD needs a degree equivalent to a Danish master's; an up-to-5-year integrated 3+5 route exists for bachelor's holders.
entry_route.quote: Option A: A three year full-time study within the framework of the regular PhD programme (5+3 scheme)

also.quote: Admission to the PhD programme is based on qualifications equivalent to a Danish two-year master's degree (120 ECTS).
Option B: An up to five year full-time study programme within the framework of the integrated MSc and PhD programme (the 3+5 scheme)

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

notes: Evidence of the programme is a Department of Chemistry job advertisement (deadline 30 Oct 2026 for that post). No separate chemistry-department admissions page was found; Faculty of SCIENCE rules apply.
